newsitem.title: USA: U.S. OPTIONS FOCUS/Iomega busy again as stock up.
newsitem.headline: U.S. OPTIONS FOCUS/Iomega busy again as stock up.

text.p: Iomega Corp options continued active on Monday as the stock extended last week's gains.
By 1440 CDT (1940 GMT), Iomega shares were ahead 7/8 at 18-3/4, off its intraday high of 19-1/8. Turnover was heavy at more than 5.7 million shares.

As on Friday last week, most of the Iomega option activity was seen on the American Stock Exchange (AMEX) and Chicago Board Options Exchange (CBOE). The options also trade on the Pacific Stock Exchange and the Philadelphia Stock Exchange.
The October 20 calls remained the most active and traders said investors were both buying and selling those options.
A total of 3,771 of the October 20 calls traded. The open interest, boosted by an addition of roughly 4,500 contracts on Friday, was nearly 8,100.
Two other active Iomega options included the November 20 and 22-1/2 calls.
On the AMEX, the November 20 call traded more than 2,000 contracts. The November 22-1/2 traded about 1,250.
Traders said an institutional investor sold 1,000 of each.
Iomega shares rallied more than three points last week, most of it coming at the end of the week after the company said its internal Zip drives would be fully bootable.
In other trading, spreads in the Borden Chemicals Inc November 10 and May 1997 10 puts and the November 12-1/2 and May 12-1/2 puts on the New York Stock Exchange were seen.
The November 10 and May 10 puts each traded 1,500 contracts and the November 12-1/2 and May 12-1/2 each traded 1,075.
Borden Chemical shares were unchanged at 9-1/4.
Also, a few call options on Diamond Shamrock Inc shares were active after the company said on Monday it agreed with Ultramar Corp to a merger of the two companies.
On the CBOE, the Diamond Shamrock October 30 call traded about 850 contracts, the October 35 call 475 and the January 1997 30 call traded 130.
Diamond Shamrock was up 3/8 at 30-5/8 in afternoon trading.
The October 30 call, down 1-3/8 at 1-3/8, had open interest of 2,275. The October 35 was down 5/8 at 5/8. Its open interest was about 1,200.
The most active Diamond Shamrock put was the October 30, with 75 contracts changing hands. It fell 1-7/16 to 11/16. Its open interest was 315.
Ultramar options, which trade on the Philadelphia Stock Exchange, were barely traded, with the most active being the October 30 call. It traded about 125 contracts. Its open interest was 30.
--Gregory Crawford, derivatives desk, (312) 408-8750
